title: DeliveryDecision
description: One immutable AUTHORIZATION or ACCEPTANCE fact recorded by Factory for a D113 delivery, deliberately separate from `delivery.evidence` (observations). D113 clause 3: worker exit, report approval, coordinator approval and issue synchronization are separate facts, and none of them is a decision here. Clause 4: a policy authorization is recorded as policy-derived, never as an owner click. Only `owner-acceptance` resolves an issue (clause 2), and only it can be referenced by a `resolve` sync request. A schema cannot authenticate an owner: Factory must only create `basis: owner` records from an authenticated owner action in its own UI (see `docs/task-delivery.md`).

kind.description: `plan-approval`: owner approves the bounded plan at `scope`. `policy-authorization`: an owner-adopted policy authorized the plan (Phase 2). `owner-acceptance`: owner tested `candidateRevision` at `deploymentId` and accepts; the only kind that may resolve the issue. `request-changes`: owner rejects and starts a linked correction. `abandon-candidate`: owner releases the per-app dev candidate hold without accepting.

basis.description: `owner`: an authenticated owner action. `policy`: derived by applying `policy`; never displayed or counted as an owner click.

actor.description: Owner identity, or the policy engine's service name.

evidence.description: Hashes of the `delivery.evidence` records shown to the decider.

hash.description: SHA-256 over this record's canonical JSON with `hash` omitted; referenced as `decisionHash`.

policyHash.description: Hash of the owner-adopted policy text in force.
